important_notes: The graph is a compressed hydrological network over 19 observed stations.
Edges represent upstream-to-downstream hydrological connectivity between observed stations.
Intermediate river reaches, confluences and reservoirs without monitored nodes may be compressed.
Geodesic distances are stored only for diagnostic purposes.
Geodesic distance is not used as an edge weight.
Laguna II has greater spatial coordinate uncertainty.
Villa Soriano is the final observed downstream station in the graph.
